types.description: Provisional generic single protective-earth terminal point; the project must wire the actual protective bonding path.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: One PE landing point is required for the sole protective bonding interface. Multiple wires on PE share that same physical point. Optional: none in this interface. Unmodeled: separate landings, rail/chassis bonds, jumpers and shields; no automatic bond or commoning to another terminal is implied. Select hardware and add bonding, conductor and current suitability data. PE is a generic protective-earth label, not a manufacturer pinout.
